annotations.title: Survey sample size + margin of error

description: Survey sample size + margin of error — Survey and poll math offline. Default: required responses for margin= percentage points (default 5) at confidence= (default 95) with p= expected percent (default 50), finite-population correction via population=, and invitations needed via response_rate= percent. Pass n= instead to get the margin of error for responses you already have. Pass sd= to switch to estimating a mean (margin in the same units). Returns required responses, margin of error, z value, an example interval and a quick table for 1-10 point margins. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: business_sample_size
